subject: Meridian deployment intake & warm-pass checklist / kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ali Raza <ali.raza@meridianhealth.org>, Lisa Martin <lisa.martin@meridianhealth.org>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Meridian deployment intake & warm-pass checklist / kickoff scheduling

Team / Ali & Lisa — attaching the signed SOW and a high-level network diagram so we can start the warm-pass planning. Quick summary of the deal and asks so CS has the context: 

- Account: Meridian Health Systems (pilot -> regional rollout)
- ARR: $180k first-year; committed Dedicated pool (4x A40-equivalent nodes)
- Product: Dedicated + Private control plane (customer VPC), model pinned to redwood-v2-13B-quant (approx latency profile shared in doc)
- Target kickoff: week of 2028-07-02; soft go-live target 2028-07-30 (pilot acceptance window: 7 days)
- Key SLOs: 95th percentile tail latency < 300ms for 512-token avg, 99.9% uptime during business hours, data residency in us-east-1

Attachments: Meridian_SOW_v3.pdf (signed), meridian_network_diagram.png
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ds-meridian-3491
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-2028-3491

Immediate asks for CS before kickoff: 
1) Confirm CS owner and implementation lead (Ben is assigning but will handoff)
2) Confirm pre-kick checklist owner: network access, certs, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence request acceptance
3) Identify technical POC(s) at Meridian (Ali/Lisa — can you confirm who the network/infra lead is?)
4) Propose a 60-90 minute kickoff session date windows (we suggested week of 2028-07-02)

Notes / risks: Meridian needs private deployment (VPC peering + strict egress rules). Procurement asked for proof of SOC 2 Type II and encryption-in-transit details — procurement contact is Lisa Martin (cc'd). There is a potential uplift request for keystore integration (HSM) post-pilot. 

Stephanie — handing this to you as primary CS owner. Karthik / Tessa: please advise if you want me to keep in the thread as we move to CS cadence or if you'd prefer a warm-handoff meeting with all stakeholders.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ali Raza <ali.raza@meridianhealth.org>, Lisa Martin <lisa.martin@meridianhealth.org>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian deployment intake & warm-pass checklist / kickoff scheduling

Thanks Ben — and congrats on getting this signed. I’ll take primary ownership of the post-sign sequence. Quick internal routing: 

- Implementation owner (PM): Tessa Morgan — she will run project cadence and acceptance criteria.
- Technical lead: Karthik Iyer — will own network/security/infra questions and the warm-pass.
- CS escalation / exec sponsor: Stephanie Nguyen (me) — will own stakeholder expectation & escalation path.

Karthik / Tessa — please confirm availability to run a 60–90 minute kickoff call in the proposed week of 2028-07-02. For planning, Karthik — please review the attached network diagram and SOW; initial technical needs: VPC peering (or PrivateLink), allowed egress CIDRs, outbound TLS termination, customer KMS for at-rest keys (if they want HSM integration we'll scope separately).

Ali / Lisa — hi, we typically run a pre-kick intake so the kickoff is focused on timelines and acceptance tests. Could you please provide the following items before the kickoff: 
- Technical POC name + email for infra/network (so Karthik can reach out)
- Confirm whether Meridian will allow AWS VPC peering (preferred) or if you require transit gateway/private link
- Any compliance artifacts you need beyond SOC 2 (e.g., penetration test report, vendor questionnaire)

Merged acceptance criteria (pilot): 
- Test corpus run with model pinned (redwood-v2-13B-quant) and three sample routes for production routing
- Latency and cost baseline comparison report by day 7 of pilot
- KV cache priming plan and expected traffic profile for warm-pass

I’ll draft a warm-pass intake checklist and share it in the next email. Tessa — once you confirm, I’ll schedule the kickoff and invite Meridian plus our infra SMEs.

-Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ali Raza <ali.raza@meridianhealth.org>, Lisa Martin <lisa.martin@meridianhealth.org>
Date: 2028-06-19T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian deployment intake & warm-pass checklist / kickoff scheduling

Looping in with a proposed technical intake & checklist — I’ll be the technical POC for Redwood. Ali / Lisa, nice to meet you. High level proposed items for pre-kick (I can run short sessions for any of these):

1) Network checklist (needed before we schedule the warm-pass):
   - Confirm VPC peering vs PrivateLink (preferred: VPC peering into our dedicated egress NAT layer)
   - Provide allowed egress CIDRs and any proxy requirements
   - Any IPS/IDS rules that would block outbound TLS to Redwood endpoints
2) Auth & keys:
   - Do you want Redwood to integrate with your KMS/HSM for at-rest encryption? If yes, please share the KMS key ARN and contact for key admin
   - Certs: will Meridian provide client certs or rely on token-based mutual auth?
3) Pilot traffic & warm-pass:
   - Expected concurrency and average token length (we have cost/latency knobs that depend on distribution)
   - A short sample dataset (sanitized) for priming and acceptance evals
4) Compliance artifacts:
   - Lisa, procurement: please confirm the exact artifacts you need; I can work with our security team to provide a tailored packet (SOC2 Type II, encryption in transit, data retention policy, limited-privilege access list).

Scheduling: I have openings for the kickoff options below (all times PDT):
- Tue 2028-07-02 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2028-07-03 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2028-07-04 10:00–11:30

If the customer prefers an eastern-window, I can shift. Tessa — if you share a calendars invite window, I’ll add the technical agenda (30 mins infra + 30 mins pilot acceptance + 30 mins runbook/ownership).

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 512-555-0177

From: Ali Raza <ali.raza@meridianhealth.org>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Martin <lisa.martin@meridianhealth.org>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian deployment intake & warm-pass checklist / kickoff scheduling

Thanks — quick answers from Meridian side: 

- We prefer VPC peering (confirming with infra) and will provide the egress CIDRs by Monday 2028-06-24.
- Technical POC: Raj Patel (raj.patel@meridianhealth.org) — network lead; cc'ing him on the follow-up separately.
- Procurement asks: Lisa will send a short vendor questionnaire (we need SOC2 Type II, encryption in transit, and proof of KMS/HSM options).
- We can do the kickoff on Tue 2028-07-02 09:00 PDT. That works for our team.

One note: we will need multi-factor auth for admin access and an approval window for production cert rollover — happy to discuss during kickoff. If you can send the warm-pass intake checklist and a calendar invite, we’ll get Raj looped in.

Regards,
Ali Raza
Director, Digital Platforms | Meridian Health Systems
ali.raza@meridianhealth.org | +1 617-555-0228
